ratings.comment: Professor Chidambairam was pretty decent. Most of the time, I could go to a lecture and come out understanding a good amount of the material. I did bomb midterm 2, hence my grade, but that was on me. Do not listen to others saying he has a thick accent; you can understand him perfectly fine.

The material itself wasn't awful, but the teacher often created his own way of doing things without explaining his reasoning, making the content seem more difficult than it actually is. Also, often explained simple steps while not explaining new content. Overall, don't go to him for questions, and self study helped more than he ever did.

Impossible to understand because of his thick accent. TA's were just as hard to understand. Your entire grade is 90% exams. Exams weren't the hardest but the class in general is quite difficult. TA grade exams so hard and take off points for the smallest things. Lectures are very dry and confusing.

To be fair, this class is generally difficult, but professor Chidambaram doesn't make it much easier. His lectures are difficult to understand and he goes quite fast. Most of the time discussion wasn't very helpful either. The test rubric was also harsh sometimes and unnecessarily deducted points.

Lectures were practically useless, the pandemic lecture recordings on Canvas were much clearer and easier to understand. Lecture is rushed through, showing formulas for a few seconds and then straight into solving, with a lot of missing steps and a lack of explanations. Questions were rarely answered directly. 87% of grade are exams.

Class wasn't terrible, but it definitely took me time to understand the material at the beginning. (I haven't read the textbook once this semester) Do the practice tests and you should be fine. Once you get to vectors it's not bad at all.

This class was the bane of my existence freshman year. During the lectures I could not understand anything he was saying and would move on way too quickly. Even during the discussion sessions where I am supposed to ask questions, I was not able to because I could not understand my TA either. Never take this class unless you have to.

Lectures were basically useless and just went through examples, skipping steps along the way that made it hard to follow along. He bases his class off of our ability to read the textbook, which we have other things to be doing.
